::: {#rem-short-codes-for-common-symbols}
#### Short codewords for common values

A code with a small [expected length](#def-expected-length)
gives frequent values short codewords and rare values long ones,
since each value's $\ell(x)$ counts in $L$ weighted by its [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability).

:::
